title: CLI users authenticate without AWS credentials
description:
As a Plexus CLI user, I want to authenticate with my Plexus application identity, so that I can run local workflows without an AWS CLI session.

Feature: Plexus application login

Scenario: Sign in from the CLI
Given no AWS credentials or Plexus access token are available
When the user runs plexus login and completes the browser authorization
Then the CLI stores refresh credentials in the operating system keychain
And plexus whoami reports the authenticated identity and account

Scenario: Refresh an expired access token
Given a valid refresh credential is stored
And the access token has expired
When an authenticated GraphQL operation runs
Then the CLI refreshes the access token without AWS intervention

Scenario: Authentication is unavailable
Given application authentication is expired or revoked
When a protected local command runs
Then it fails with guidance to run plexus login
And it does not use AWS SSO or an API key

Scenario: Sign out
Given the user is authenticated
When the user runs plexus logout
Then stored refresh credentials are removed
And subsequent protected commands require plexus login

Exclusions: Remote task execution and shared API-key authentication.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Implementation detail added: the official CLI flow uses Cognito authorization-code plus S256 PKCE with the fixed registered callback http://127.0.0.1:8765/callback. The callback binds only to loopback, validates state with constant-time comparison, stops after its single response, and reports an occupied port clearly. Runtime discovery contract: PLEXUS_COGNITO_DOMAIN is the HTTPS hosted-authorization domain, PLEXUS_COGNITO_CLIENT_ID is the User Pool application client ID, and PLEXUS_COGNITO_REGION carries deployment identity metadata. Only standard Cognito claims such as sub and email are used; account membership remains server-side. The credentials boundary is OS-keychain refresh credential only; bearer access tokens are refreshed on demand.

comments.author: ryan.porter
comments.text: Clarification for the existing account-reporting acceptance: this lane exposes standard Cognito identity only. It does not create or require an account-membership custom claim; any account or resource relationship remains a server-side authorization concern.
